name: swarnalekh
description: SwarnaLekh — Multi-tenant jewellery shop management SaaS

scripts.dev:web:local: pnpm mobile:env:sync && bash scripts/flutter_with_env.sh run -d chrome
scripts.format:check: bash -lc 'set -euo pipefail; files=$(git diff --cached --name-only --diff-filter=ACMR | grep -E "\.(ts|tsx|js|json|md)$" || true); if [ -n "$files" ]; then printf "%s\n" "$files" | xargs ./node_modules/.bin/prettier --check --ignore-unknown; else echo "No staged Prettier files to check."; fi; dart format --set-exit-if-changed apps/mobile/lib apps/mobile/test'
scripts.verify:precommit: pnpm format:check && pnpm test && pnpm build && pnpm mobile:analyze && pnpm mobile:test && pnpm mobile:build
scripts.vercel:build:api: pnpm --filter api prisma:generate && pnpm --filter api build
scripts.railway:build:api: pnpm --filter api prisma:generate && pnpm --filter api build
